_comment: APPEND-ONLY. One JSON object per line, one spend per line. This is the STRUCTURED twin of the spend prose in money-ledger.md, and it holds the same facts in the same words - the ledger stays the narrative and the source of truth, this is what a machine can add up. It exists because a category total has to come from somewhere: the ledger's Out column is a sentence, so the site could only ever show N0 against every category. Rows here are the same rows that go to the sheet's Expenses tab, which is why the site and the sheet agree by construction. Written at the reckoning, alongside the ledger row, never instead of it. Fields: date, category (must match a category in tools/sheets/plan.json), amount, what, note.

note: His words: 'I spent money on recharge card today in my bank account, 1k recharge'.
His words: 'I spent 2k on helping someone with recharge card'. Logged on the date reported; he did not give the exact day.
Closes the N360 gap between the 27 Aug balance of N2,503 and the N143 reported on 2 Sep. His answer: it went on a recharge.
